claim.claim-text: 1. A separator for a lithium battery, the separator comprising:

• a porous separator layer (20) which comprises: - one or more inorganic oxides or nitrides; and - a polymer binder; and • one or more reinforcement area (52), which provides reinforcement at one or more of the edges of the separator, wherein the reinforcement area comprises a layer of polymer which overlays the porous separator layer (20).
2. The separator of claim 1, wherein the porous separator layer further comprises an anionic compound.
3. The separator of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the separator is free-standing.
4. The separator of any one of claims 1-3, wherein the separator has been slit to its final width and therefore the porous separator layer (20) comprises slit edges.
5. The separator of claim 4, wherein a reinforcement area (52) is disposed on or near at least one of the slit edges.

6. The separator of any one of claims 1-5, wherein said one or more reinforcement areas (52) cover the entire surface of the porous separator layer (20) between the locations for electrode coating material (40a, 40b).

7. The separator of any one of claims 1-6, wherein at least a portion of the polymer comprised in the reinforcement area is impregnated in at least a portion of pores of the porous separator layer (20).
8. The separator of any one of claims 1-7, wherein at least a portion of the polymer comprised in the reinforcement area is coated over or laminated to the porous separator layer.
9. The separator of any one of claims 1-8, wherein there are a plurality of reinforcement areas (52) providing reinforcement at the edges of the separator.
10. The separator of any one of claims 1-9, wherein the one or more inorganic oxides or nitrides includes boehmite.

an anode, a cathode, wherein the cathode comprises one or more transition metals, an electrolyte, and a separator interposed between the cathode and the anode, wherein the separator is as defined in any one of claims 1-10.
12. The lithium battery of claim 11, wherein the anode comprises lithium metal.
13. The lithium battery of claim 11 or claim 12, wherein the cathode comprises one or more transition metals selected from the group consisting of manganese, nickel and cobalt.

14. The lithium battery of any one of claims 11-13, wherein an electrode coating layer is coated on the entire surface of the separator layer (20), or is provided in lanes or strips on the separator layer (20), or is provided in patches or rectangle shapes on the separator layer (20).
15. The lithium battery of claim 14, wherein said one or more reinforcement areas (52) cover the entire surface of the porous separator layer (20) between the electrode coating layers (40a, 40b).
